questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates the candidate's ability to design end-to-end tenant onboarding, isolation, governance, and observability in Azure DevOps at production scale.

## Key Concepts
- Parameterized YAML templates and conditional deployment
- Per-tenant resource isolation: Resource Group, App Service plan, deployment slot
- App Configuration and Key Vault integration
- Database seeding and tenant-specific tests in isolated environments
- Policy gates and drift detection
- Rollback strategy and per-tenant auditing to Azure Monitor

## Code Example
```yaml
trigger: none

parameters:
  - name: tenantId
    type: string
    displayName: 'Tenant ID'
  - name: tenantDomain
    type: string
    displayName: 'Tenant Domain'

variables:
  azureServiceConnection: 'azure-spn'
  subscriptionId: '$(AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID)'
  resourceGroupName: 'rg-$(tenantId)'
  appServicePlanName: 'asp-$(tenantId)'
  appServiceName: 'api-$(tenantId)'
  appConfigName: 'appconfig-$(tenantId)'
  keyVaultName: 'kv-shared-01'
  databaseServerName: 'sql-$(tenantId)'
  databaseName: 'db-$(tenantId)'

stages:
  - stage: Provision
    displayName: 'Provision Tenant Resources'
    jobs:
      - job: ProvisionResources
        displayName: 'Provision Infrastructure'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create Resource Group'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az group create --name $(resourceGroupName) --location eastus
                az configure --defaults group=$(resourceGroupName)

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create App Service Plan'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az appservice plan create --name $(appServicePlanName) --sku S1 --is-linux

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create App Service with Deployment Slot'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az webapp create --name $(appServiceName) --plan $(appServicePlanName) --runtime 'NODE|18-lts'
                az webapp deployment slot create --name $(appServiceName) --slot staging

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create SQL Database'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az sql server create --name $(databaseServerName) --resource-group $(resourceGroupName) --location eastus
                az sql db create --name $(databaseName) --server $(databaseServerName) --service-tier Basic

  - stage: Configure
    displayName: 'Configure Tenant'
    dependsOn: Provision
    jobs:
      - job: LoadConfiguration
        displayName: 'Load Settings and Secrets'
        steps:
          - task: AzureKeyVault@2
            displayName: 'Fetch Tenant Secrets'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              KeyVaultName: $(keyVaultName)
              SecretsFilter: '*'
              RunAsPreJob: false

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Configure App Settings'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az webapp config appsettings set --name $(appServiceName) --slot staging --settings \
                  TENANT_ID=$(tenantId) \
                  TENANT_DOMAIN=$(tenantDomain) \
                  DATABASE_CONNECTION_STRING='Server=tcp:$(databaseServerName).database.windows.net,1433;Database=$(databaseName);User ID=$(keyVaultTenantUser);Password=$(keyVaultTenantPassword);Encrypt=true;'

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Seed Database'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                sqlcmd -S $(databaseServerName).database.windows.net -d $(databaseName) -U $(keyVaultTenantUser) -P $(keyVaultTenantPassword) -i seed-tenant.sql

  - stage: Deploy
    displayName: 'Deploy to Staging'
    dependsOn: Configure
    jobs:
      - job: DeployApplication
        displayName: 'Deploy to Staging Slot'
        steps:
          - task: AzureWebApp@1
            displayName: 'Deploy to Staging Slot'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              appType: 'webApp'
              appName: $(appServiceName)
              deployToSlotOrASE: true
              resourceGroupName: $(resourceGroupName)
              slotName: 'staging'

  - stage: Test
    displayName: 'Run Tests'
    dependsOn: Deploy
    jobs:
      - job: RunTests
        displayName: 'Execute Tenant Tests'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Run Unit Tests'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                npm test -- --tenantId=$(tenantId) --environment=staging

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Run Integration Tests'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                npm run test:integration -- --tenantId=$(tenantId) --environment=staging

  - stage: GateAndPolicy
    displayName: 'Policy Gates & Drift Check'
    dependsOn: Test
    jobs:
      - job: PolicyCheck
        displayName: 'Verify Policy Compliance'
        steps:
          - task: AzurePolicy@0
            displayName: 'Check Azure Policy Compliance'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              resourceGroupName: $(resourceGroupName)
              definitionId: '/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/policyDefinitions/...' 

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Drift Detection'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az deployment group show --resource-group $(resourceGroupName) --name initial-deployment
                # Compare current state with desired state

  - stage: Promote
    displayName: 'Promote to Production'
    dependsOn: GateAndPolicy
    condition: succeeded()
    jobs:
      - job: SwapSlots
        displayName: 'Swap Staging to Production'
        steps:
          - task: AzureAppServiceManage@0
            displayName: 'Swap Staging to Production'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              Action: 'Swap Slots'
              WebAppName: $(appServiceName)
              ResourceGroupName: $(resourceGroupName)
              SourceSlot: 'staging'

  - stage: Audit
    displayName: 'Audit & Logging'
    dependsOn: Promote
    jobs:
      - job: LogAuditTrail
        displayName: 'Send Audit Logs to Azure Monitor'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Log Tenant Onboarding'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az monitor app-insights trace show \
                  --location eastus \
                  --query "[?operationName == 'tenant-onboarding']"

                # Send custom event
                az monitor app-insights events show --app $(appInsightsName) --type customEvents
```

This YAML pipeline demonstrates a complete tenant onboarding workflow with infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, testing, policy enforcement, and production deployment with full audit logging capabilities.

questions.explanation:
## Why This Question Is Asked

This question validates expertise in multi-tenant onboarding automation, resource isolation, sustainable IaC practices, and production-grade governance in CI/CD pipelines.

## Key Concepts

- **Tenant onboarding automation**: Streamlining the provisioning of new tenants through automated pipelines
- **Per-tenant resource isolation**: Using IaC (Terraform or Bicep) to create dedicated, isolated resources per tenant
- **GitOps reconciliation**: Declarative configuration management with FluxCD
- **Secret management**: Secure handling of secrets via Azure Key Vault and configuration settings through App Configuration
- **Production gates**: Enforcing governance with RBAC and Azure Policy
- **Drift detection and auto-cleanup**: Ensuring infrastructure consistency and automatic rollback on failure
- **Observability**: Comprehensive logging to Azure Monitor for monitoring and auditing

## Code Example

```yaml
# Simplified implementation
trigger:
  branches:
    include:
      - main
  paths:
    include:
      - tenants/*

variables:
  azureSubscription: 'Azure-Connection'
  gitopsRepo: 'https://github.com/org/gitops-repo'

stages:
  - stage: Provision_Tenant
    jobs:
      - job: Create_Resources
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Provision Infrastructure'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureSubscription)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                TENANT_ID=$(Build.SourceBranchName)
                RESOURCE_GROUP="rg-$TENANT_ID"
                
                # Create Resource Group
                az group create --name $RESOURCE_GROUP --location eastus
                
                # Provision AKS Namespace
                az aks create -g $RESOURCE_GROUP -n aks-$TENANT_ID
                
                # Create App Configuration
                az appconfig create -n appcfg-$TENANT_ID -g $RESOURCE_GROUP
                
                # Create Key Vault
                az keyvault create -n kv-$TENANT_ID -g $RESOURCE_GROUP
                
                echo "##vso[task.setvariable variable=resourceGroup]$RESOURCE_GROUP"
                echo "##vso[task.setvariable variable=tenantId]$TENANT_ID"

  - stage: Build_Tenant_Image
    dependsOn: Provision_Tenant
    jobs:
      - job: Build_Image
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: Docker@2
            displayName: 'Build Tenant-Specific Image'
            inputs:
              containerRegistry: 'ContainerRegistry'
              repository: '$(tenantId)'
              command: 'build'
              Dockerfile: '**/Dockerfile'
              tags: '$(Build.BuildNumber)'

  - stage: GitOps_Sync
    dependsOn: Build_Tenant_Image
    jobs:
      - job: Sync_Manifests
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - bash: |
              # Update GitOps repo with new tenant manifests
              git clone $(gitopsRepo)
              cd gitops-repo
              
              cat > tenants/$(tenantId)/namespace.yaml << EOF
              apiVersion: v1
              kind: Namespace
              metadata:
                name: $(tenantId)
              EOF
              
              git add tenants/$(tenantId)/
              git commit -m "Add tenant: $(tenantId)"
              git push
            displayName: 'Update GitOps Repository'

  - stage: Production_Gate
    dependsOn: GitOps_Sync
    condition: succeeded()
    jobs:
      - job: RBAC_Policy_Check
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Verify RBAC Compliance'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureSubscription)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              inlineScript: |
                az policy assignment list \
                  --scope "/subscriptions/$(subscriptionId)/resourceGroups/$(resourceGroup)" \
                  --query "[?enforcementMode=='DoNotEnforce']" \
                  --output table

  - stage: Drift_Detection
    dependsOn: Production_Gate
    jobs:
      - job: Check_Drift
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Detect Configuration Drift'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureSubscription)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              inlineScript: |
                # Run drift detection
                az terraform show

  - stage: Auto_Cleanup_On_Failure
    dependsOn: Drift_Detection
    condition: failed()
    jobs:
      - job: Cleanup_Resources
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Rollback Tenant Resources'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureSubscription)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              inlineScript: |
                az group delete --name $(resourceGroup) --yes --no-wait
                echo "Tenant $(tenantId) resources cleaned up due to onboarding failure."

  - stage: Secret_Rotation
    dependsOn: Production_Gate
    jobs:
      - job: Rotate_Secrets
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Rotate Key Vault Secrets'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureSubscription)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              inlineScript: |
                KEYVAULT_NAME="kv-$(tenantId)"
                az keyvault secret set --vault-name $KEYVAULT_NAME \
                  --name "db-password" \
                  --value $(uuidgen)

  - stage: Azure_Monitor_Logging
    dependsOn:
      - Provision_Tenant
      - Build_Tenant_Image
      - GitOps_Sync
      - Production_Gate
      - Drift_Detection
      - Auto_Cleanup_On_Failure
      - Secret_Rotation
    jobs:
      - job: Log_To_Insights
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Send Pipeline Metrics to Azure Monitor'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureSubscription)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              inlineScript: |
                TENANT_ID=$(tenantId)
                az monitor app-insights create \
                  --app "appinsights-$TENANT_ID" \
                  --location eastus
                
                az monitor log-analytics query \
                  --workspace "log-workspace" \
                  --query "let table = dynamic({'Tenant': '$TENANT_ID', 'Status': 'Completed', 'Timestamp': now()}); table"
```

3. How do you handle cross-tenant resource quotas and throttling in a shared AKS cluster?

## Why This Is Asked

Tests fundamentals of pipeline structure, secrets management, feature flags, and gating in a real-world but beginner-friendly scenario.

## Key Concepts
- YAML-based multi-stage pipelines with environments and approvals
- Secure secret retrieval (Azure Key Vault) and per-env configuration (App Configuration)
- Docker image lifecycle (build, push to ACR, deploy to App Service)
- Rollback strategies and observability (Smoke tests, Log Analytics)

## Code Example
```yaml
# Example skeleton is provided; adapt to project specifics
trigger:
  - main

stages:
- stage: BuildTest
  jobs:
  - job: Test
    pool: 'Ubuntu-latest'
    steps:
    - task: NodeTool@0
      inputs:
        versionSpec: '14.x'
    - script: npm ci
      displayName: 'Install dependencies'
    - script: npm test
      displayName: 'Run tests'

- stage: Publish
  dependsOn: BuildTest
  jobs:
  - job: BuildImage
    steps:
    - script: docker build -t ${{ variables.registries }}:latest .
      displayName: 'Build image'
    - script: docker push ${{ variables.registries }}:latest
      displayName: 'Push image'

- stage: Deploy
  dependsOn: Publish
  jobs:
  - job: DeployStaging
    steps:
    - task: AzureKeyVault@2
      inputs:
        connectedServiceName: 'AZURE_SERVICE_CONNECTION'
        keyVaultName: 'my-keyvault-staging'
    - task: AzureAppConfiguration@1
      inputs:
        connectedServiceName: 'AZURE_SERVICE_CONNECTION'
        configStoreName: 'myappconfig-staging'
    - task: AzureWebApp@1
      inputs:
        appName: 'myapp-staging'
        package: '$(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/**/app.zip'
  - job: DeployProd
    dependsOn: DeployStaging
    condition: &prodGate
      eq( variables['prodGate'], 'true' )
    steps:
    - task: ManualValidation@0
      inputs:
        instructions: 'Approve to deploy to production'
        onTimeout: 'reject'
    - task: AzureKeyVault@2
      inputs:
        connectedServiceName: 'AZURE_SERVICE_CONNECTION'
        keyVaultName: 'my-keyvault-prod'
    - task: AzureAppConfiguration@1
      inputs:
        connectedServiceName: 'AZURE_SERVICE_CONNECTION'
        configStoreName: 'myappconfig-prod'
    - task: AzureWebApp@1
      inputs:
        appName: 'myapp-prod'
        package: '$(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/**/app.zip'

- stage: Validate
  dependsOn: Deploy
  jobs:
  - job: SmokeTest
    steps:
    - script: ./scripts/smoke-test.sh
      displayName: 'Run smoke test'
```

## Follow-up Questions

## Why This Is Asked
This question assesses end-to-end continuous deployment skills, safe production gating strategies, and integration with Azure's configuration and secrets management services. It ensures you can model deployment slots, implement lightweight load tests, and configure rollback paths in a beginner-friendly pipeline context.

## Key Concepts
- Azure DevOps YAML pipelines and staging strategies
- Azure Functions deployment slots for zero-downtime deployments
- App Configuration for per-environment settings
- Key Vault integration via managed identity for secrets
- Load testing with k6 for performance validation
- Gate-based promotion with latency and error rate thresholds
- Azure Monitor Logs for pipeline diagnostics

## Code Example
```yaml
trigger:
  - main

variables:
  azureServiceConnection: 'azure-sp'
  functionAppName: 'my-function-app'
  appConfigName: 'my-app-config'
  keyVaultName: 'my-key-vault'

stages:
  - stage: Build
    jobs:
      - job: Build
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: NodeTool@0
            inputs:
              versionSpec: '18.x'
          - script: npm install
          - script: npm run build
          - publish: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/dist
            artifact: drop

  - stage: Test_Audit
    dependsOn: Build
    jobs:
      - job: Test_and_Lint
        steps:
          - task: NodeTool@0
            inputs:
              versionSpec: '18.x'
          - script: npm install
          - script: npm run lint
          - script: npm test
      - job: Security_Audit
        steps:
          - task: NodeTool@0
            inputs:
              versionSpec: '18.x'
          - script: npm install
          - script: npm audit --audit-level=moderate

  - stage: Deploy_Staging
    dependsOn: Test_Audit
    variables:
      environment: 'staging'
    jobs:
      - deployment: DeployToStaging
        environment: 'staging'
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - task: AzureKeyVault@1
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    KeyVaultName: $(keyVaultName)
                    SecretsFilter: '*'
                - task: AzureAppConfiguration@1
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    AppConfigurationEndpoint: 'https://$(appConfigName).azconfig.io'
                    labels: 'staging'
                - task: AzureFunctionApp@1
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    appType: 'functionApp'
                    appName: $(functionAppName)
                    deploySlot: true
                    slotName: 'staging'
                    package: '$(Pipeline.Workspace)/dist/*.zip'

  - stage: Load_Test
    dependsOn: Deploy_Staging
    jobs:
      - job: Run_k6
        steps:
          - task: k6LoadTest@1
            inputs:
              filePath: 'tests/load-test.js'
             vus: '50'
              duration: '30s'
              threshold: 'p95=1200,error_rate=1'

  - stage: Promote_or_Rollback
    dependsOn: Load_Test
    jobs:
      - job: Check_conditions
        steps:
          - task: PowerShell@2
            inputs:
              targetType: 'inline'
              script: |
                $metrics = @{
                  p95Latency = 1150
                  errorRate = 0.5
                }
                if ($metrics.p95Latency -lt 1200 -and $metrics.errorRate -lt 1) {
                  Write-Host "Promoting to production"
                } else {
                  Write-Host "##vso[task.logissue type=error]Promote conditions not met"
                  exit 1
                }
      - job: Promote_to_Production
        dependsOn: Check_conditions
        condition: succeeded()
        steps:
          - task: AzureFunctionApp@1
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              appType: 'functionApp'
              appName: $(functionAppName)
              deploySlot: true
              slotName: 'staging'
              swapWithProduction: true
      - job: Rollback_on_Failure
        dependsOn: Check_conditions
        condition: failed()
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az functionApp deployment slot swap \
                  --resource-group my-rg \
                  --name $(functionAppName) \
                  --slot staging \
                  --target-slot production
          - task: AzureMonitor@1
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              alertsToSearch: 'all'
              insightsToSearch: 'all'
```

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests the ability to produce a concrete, beginner-friendly pipeline tying tests, containerization, per-environment secrets, and rollout safety.

## Key Concepts
- Azure Pipelines YAML
- ACR and App Service deployment slots
- smoke tests and conditional deployments
- Key Vault / App Configuration integration
- telemetry correlation via correlation-id

## Code Example
```yaml
# Minimal skeleton
trigger:
  branches:
    include: [ main ]
pr:
  branches:
    include: [ main ]
pool:
  vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
stages:
- stage: Build
  jobs:
  - job: Test
    steps:
    - script: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
    - script: pytest --cov=.
    - task: PublishTestResults@2
      inputs: { testResultsFiles: '**/pytest*.xml' }
- stage: Deploy
  dependsOn: Build
  jobs:
  - job: DeployToStaging
    steps:
    - script: docker build -t myacr.azurecr.io/myapi:$(Build.BuildId) .
    - script: docker push myacr.azurecr.io/myapi:$(Build.BuildId)
    - task: AzureWebAppContainer@1
      inputs:
        appName: 'myapi-staging'
        containers: 'myacr.azurecr.io/myapi:$(Build.BuildId)'
- stage: ProductionSwap
  dependsOn: Deploy
  condition: succeeded()
  jobs:
  - job: Swap
    steps:
    - script: az webapp deployment slot swap --name myapi --resource-group RG --slot staging --target-slot production
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you handle failed smoke tests gracefully? 
- How to rotate secrets without redeploying?
